text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. First, break large tasks into smaller steps and set a simple schedule. Next, prioritization is key: decide which tasks are most urgent and do them first. It also helps to manage the scope of your work. If a project is too big, focus on the most important parts instead of trying to do everything. Finally, communication matters. If you think you may miss a deadline, tell your team or manager early. They can often help you adjust the plan. With these habits, deadlines feel less stressful and more manageable.
